sideA.text: Turn this card over to calculate your final score.

sideB.text:
Games Won: 50 points per game won in the first half of the month. 30 points per game won in the second half of the month.
Population: Total population of all locations on the grid.
Bonuses: 100 points for delivering the sample. 25 points for each lab on the board.
Subtotal: Games Won + Population + Bonuses.
Penalties: -5 points for each forsaken city on the grid.
Grand Total: Subtotal - Penalties.

mechanics.whenRead: After 12-05 and the matching outcome card (12-06 or 12-07), when the campaign has ended. The total selects a tier on 12-09 through 12-12.
triggers: Campaign end, after the delivery outcome card

mechanics.notes: Side B is a ledger with a write-in box on each line. Games Won has one box for each of the two rates. The lab line is marked with a yellow lab-flask icon. The penalty line and the Grand Total box are highlighted yellow. The card prints a minus before 5 and before Penalties.
